card.name: Digits inside dollar amounts
card.fires_on: Digits (or the dollar sign) within a dollar amount, just before million or billion. Seen in news about funding, fines, deals and losses.

modes.label: Digit after dollar sign
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a dollar figure, often right after a decimal point, before billion or million.
modes.example: of dollars, including $1.<<4>> billion for the US Border Patrol·alone

modes.label: Dollar sign itself
modes.description: The $ symbol just before an amount of money.

card.writes: It pushes toward finance words such as capital, liquidity, bond and bonds.
card.plain: It lights up on the numbers inside money amounts like $1.4 billion in news about funding or fines.
